title: Page 28
transc:
New York Feb 18th 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft. M.
ninety three Franklin Street Midas 18th
Feby sixty three for Lt vesper
Chas Whipple formerly of nineteenth Calendar
squadron Care Capt John Curry a
C S Hammock War Department has
authorized investigation of Vieles case send
me tonight your copy if statement
made to Whiting will communicate further 
with you signed H S Olcott
Venus and special Comr Clear Cold
John Horner


Ft Monroe Feb 20 1864
Maj Eckert Di
Arabia please have venus Boyd late
Vinton of Mack Cooks Wharton and
an Escaped prisoner from Negus who
will call upon you to day
detailed for service in this depart
meant his knowledge of the condition
of the prisoners and of Neptune
and of the means of communicating
with them will be of the
greatest advantage to us abbey cold
Geo D Sheldon
